scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Merry Christmas!
I have a gift for you! Ho Ho Ho!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
圣诞快乐！
我有一份礼物要送给你！呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
I'm having a bit of a problem...
Do you care to listen?
scripts.translation:
我遇到了一点麻烦...
你愿意听我说说吗？

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
My problem is this.
There seems to be a man out there
that is impersonating me and spreading
terror throughout the land.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
我的麻烦是这样的。
似乎有个家伙冒充我，
在各地制造恐慌。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Like the Grinch of legend, he's taking
all the childrens' toys and keeping them
for himself.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
就像传说中的格林奇一样，
他抢走了所有孩子的玩具，
据为己有。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
I'm too busy here creating my batch of 
toys for next year, so I can't go
out and find him myself.
So I would like you to go out and
Destroy this man for me.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
我现在正忙着制作明年的玩具，
没法亲自去找他。
所以我想请你去
替我消灭这个家伙。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
He has in his posession one of my
magic sacks, however, so he will
escape into it to another place each
time you attack him.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
他身上带着我的一个
魔法袋子，所以每次你攻击他，
他都会逃进袋子里去别的地方。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
However,
In his haste, he tends to drop things.
If by chance he drops one of his Stockings
With Holes that he uses to steal the
poor childrens' toys, pick it up.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
不过，
他在匆忙中往往会掉落东西。
如果他掉落了用来偷走
可怜孩子玩具的破洞长袜，
请捡起来。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
If you collect 3 of these, I will give
you a prototype mystery box that
I've been keeping around the
lab. It spits out random presents
and saves me a ton of work.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
如果你收集到3个这样的袜子，
我会给你我实验室里留着的
一个原型神秘盒子。
它会随机吐出礼物，
能帮我省不少力气。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
Seems you've been doing a
good job of taking down those
fake Santas. Keep it up!
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
看来你消灭那些
假圣诞老人的工作做得不错。
继续加油！

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
There's your reward.
If you get 3 more, I'll give you another.
Hope you get a good item.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
这是你的奖励。
如果你再收集3个，我会再给你一个。
希望你能开出好东西。

scripts.text:
You don't have enough socks as proof.
Go take down those evil Santas
and get more for me and I'll reward you.
scripts.translation:
你手上的袜子证据不够。
去消灭那些邪恶的假圣诞老人，
多拿点来给我，我会奖励你的。

scripts.text:
[Santa Claus]
I see. Well, at the very least
we shall meet again on Christmas morning.
scripts.translation:
[圣诞老人]
我明白了。那么，至少
我们还会在圣诞节早晨再见的。
